append.detail: Follow-up from actual shared member-shell axe failures: the default skin wrapper rebound primary-strong to the fill accent, bypassing the existing daytime text step. The alias now keeps that same text step on default-skin Commons, preserving night and Stage. New focused regression tests cover the three reported backgrounds and unchanged dark/Stage states. Search, You and Vault controls use their visible shortcut/standing/counters in native accessible names; the You identity remains a description and the compact You name remains explicit. Existing contrast probes, thresholds and pins are unchanged. Focused source/rendered checks pass; full exact-head CI, rendered axe and production verification remain required. Completed first exact-head rendered run reports no serious color-contrast violations and no original Search/You/Vault name targets; the complete gate still failed other controls. Follow-up scope includes native console identity names with visible roles, reaction/comment names with visible counters, hero link badge context, contiguous practice action names, and existing 44px target utilities on the footer motion control. Ninety-four focused tests across thirteen suites and scoped lint pass; local type checking is pending under the repository CI heap setting. Full renewed rendered/visual and production acceptance are not claimed; existing waivers, baselines and thresholds remain untouched.
